title: Repair the C6c independent matrix contract without changing product bytes
goal: Replace structurally impossible universal zero-match and single-rule assumptions with hash-bound detector-specific non-vacuity and rule-coupling contracts, then supply only genuinely missing independent fixtures and resume C6c on a fresh candidate.
acceptanceCriteria: A machine-readable contract covers all 37 modules, 80 blocking rules and three advisories, binds every adapter hash, and permits fixed-checklist non-vacuity or coupled rules only with exact reviewed source facts.
A verifier rejects missing or stale classifications, unknown ownership, invalid non-vacuity identities, asymmetric or overbroad coupling and any unrecognized field.

The matrix runner keeps strict C/M semantics and 191-row cardinality, validates exact finding identities and immutable roots, and records the verified Z strategy and V coupling for every applicable row.

Supplemental fixtures execute the frozen composed adapters and supply every residual missing row from hash-bound disposable inputs without changing module, detector, producer, policy, baseline or published 1.1.3 bytes.

A fresh implementation-bound candidate, seven locks and synthetic review complete the Windows matrix and remaining confinement controls before identical fixture bytes and semantic projections pass on pinned offline Linux; otherwise the decision remains blocked.
Formal Pre, isolated IFX Package regression and exact committed Formal Diff pass; no C6d/C6e, P10.2/P10.3 or V3-retirement claim is made.
